# Model Fitting Setup Validation

Make the estimand and fitted data explicit before comparing or accepting
models.

## Setup

Resolve the applicable choices:

- requested output: prediction, optimum location, response at the optimum,
  model metric, coefficient, p-value, class, or another quantity;
- response and predictor definitions, units, transformations, and category or
  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;
- candidate models, formulas, fixed parameters, and fitting implementation;
- comparison metric and convention

# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "base64 -w0 <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) "'!= 1L) stop("Expected one input CSV")
d <- read.csv(args[[1]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
strain <- as.character(d$StrainNumber)
ratio <- as.character(d$Ratio)
area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$Area))
pure98 <- strain == "98"
pure287 <- strain == "287"
mix <- strain == "287_98"
frequency <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
frequency[pure98] <- 0
frequency[pure287] <- 1
parts <- strsplit(ratio[mix], ":", fixed = TRUE)
frequency[mix] <- vapply(parts, function(z) {
  if (length(z) != 2L) stop("Invalid mixture ratio")
  a <- as.numeric(z[[1]])
  b <- as.numeric(z[[2]])
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a < 0 || b < 0 || a + b <= 0) stop("Invalid mixture ratio values")
  a / (a + b)
}, numeric(1))
keep <- (pure98 | pure287 | mix) & is.finite(frequency) & is.finite(area)
fitdat <- data.frame(frequency = frequency[keep], area = area[keep])
if (nrow(fitdat) < 6L) stop("Too few complete observations")
if (!identical(range(fitdat$frequency), c(0, 1))) stop("Expected observed p=0 and p=1 boundaries")
models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(area ~ poly(frequency, 2, raw = TRUE), data = fitdat),
  cubic = lm(area ~ poly(frequency, 3, raw = TRUE), data = fitdat),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(area ~ splines::ns(frequency, df = 4), data = fitdat)
)
model_n <- vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1))
if (length(unique(model_n)) != 1L || model_n[[1]] != nrow(fitdat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
aic <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(which.min(aic))[[1]]
best <- models[[best_name]]
lo <- min(fitdat$frequency)
hi <- max(fitdat$frequency)
grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 100001L)
grid_pred <- as.numeric(predict(best, newdata = data.frame(frequency = grid)))
i <- which.max(grid_pred)
left <- grid[max(1L, i - 2L)]
right <- grid[min(length(grid), i + 2L)]
refined <- optimize(
  function(x) as.numeric(predict(best, newdata = data.frame(frequency = x))),
  interval = c(left, right), maximum = TRUE, tol = .Machine$double.eps''^0.5
)
candidate_x <- c(lo, hi, refined$maximum)
candidate_y <- as.numeric(predict(best, newdata = data.frame(frequency = candidate_x)))
j <- which.max(candidate_y)
optimum_frequency <- candidate_x[[j]]
maximum_predicted_area <- candidate_y[[j]]
out <- data.frame(
  n = nrow(fitdat),
  scope = "287_98 mixtures plus pure 98 and pure 287 boundaries",
  selection_metric = "minimum AIC",
  quadratic_AIC = aic[["quadratic"]],
  cubic_AIC = aic[["cubic"]],
  natural_spline_df4_AIC = aic[["natural_spline_df4"]],
  selected_model = best_name,
  domain_min = lo,
  domain_max = hi,
  optimum_frequency = optimum_frequency,
  maximum_predicted_area = maximum_predicted_area,
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(out, file = "model_result.tsv", sep = "'"\\t\", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, digits = 15)
RSCRIPT"
